statements.query: MATCH (n:GCPLabel)<-[:LABELED]-(m)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Delete GCP Labels that no longer exist and detach them from all previously connected nodes.

statements.query: MATCH (:GCPLabel)<-[r:LABELED]-(m)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Remove GCP Resource-to-Label relationships that are out of date.

statements.query: MATCH (n:GCPLabel)<-[:LABELED]-(m:GCPKMSCryptoKey)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPKMSKeyRing)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Same as the first statement, for labels on resources owned by a parent resource rather than directly by the project (see OWNERSHIP_PATHS in intel/gcp/label.py).

statements.__comment__: Same as the second statement, for the nested ownership path.
